6012-8095--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
6012-8095--5--195.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Reluctant Role Model trigger.
Resolve Reluctant Role Model's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2852-4551-8089.description:
Activate Doom Whisperer by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

2034-4289-6970-7730-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

1619-4605-5542-6139-6797.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5542-6139-6797.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Caves of Chaos Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Caves of Chaos Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Caves of Chaos Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Caves of Chaos Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Caves of Chaos Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Caves of Chaos Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Caves of Chaos Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Caves of Chaos Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5542-6139-6797.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

4478-5921-5970-7014.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of North Pole Patrol.
Activate one of the North Pole Patrol tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other North Pole Patrol token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

147-3967-5188.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-3967-5188.description:
Cast Dread Return by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Dread Return.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Dread Return
Resolve the Dread Return copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

413-4668-4907-6989.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least three cards this turn.
413-4668-4907-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Heliod. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
When Tatterkite enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

719-3000-7304.description:
Cast Genghis Frog by paying {G}{U}
When Genghis Frog enters, it triggers, creating a Mutagen token and a creature token due to Chatterfang.
When the creature token enters as a Mutant due to Xenograft, Genghis Frog triggers, creating a Mutagen token and a creature token due to Chatterfang.
Repeat step 3.
719-3000-7304.notes: Step 3 creates a mandatory infinite loop that will cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.

509-1267-5546-5776.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Jhoira's Timebug does not have summoning sickness.
509-1267-5546-5776.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Activate Jhoira's Timebug by tapping it, putting a time counter on Idris.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 5.

176-3000-5686.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional non-Spirit creature.
176-3000-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
176-3000-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a non-Spirit creature
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating two creature tokens due to Chatterfang.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood artifact token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat.

643-2366-5411-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
643-2366-5411-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-5205-6972.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Glint-Sleeve Artisan.
When Glint-Sleeve Artisan dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Glint-Sleeve Artisan enters, its fabricate ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Glint-Sleeve Artisan trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2770-6848-6849.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to proliferate or a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Bloodcrazed Hoplite after an opponent gains control of it.
2770-6848-6849.description:
Donate control of Bloodcrazed Hoplite to an opponent.
Put a +1/+1 counter on Bloodcrazed Hoplite either by proliferating or by any other method.
Bloodcrazed Hoplite triggers, targeting any creature controlled by you or another opponent.
When the opponent commits that crime, Patrolling Peacemaker triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a +1/+1 counter on Bloodcrazed Hoplite.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-4613-4679-4894--128.manaNeeded: {2} plus enough mana to activate the Licid's ability
2034-4613-4679-4894--128.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to activate the Licid's ability.
2034-4613-4679-4894--128.description:
Activate Breaching Hippocamp using the Licid's ability by paying its activation cost, attaching Breaching Hippocamp to Yenna and causing Breaching Hippocamp to become an Aura.
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Breaching Hippocamp.
When the Breaching Hippocamp token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Breaching Hippocamp token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

539-570-4657.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three colors among permanents you control.
539-570-4657.description:
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{W}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Faeburrow Elder.
Repeat.

2281-2921-3175.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Sun Titan.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Saffi triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

372-3647-4477.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Displace exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-3647-4477.description:
Cast Displace by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Greenwarden of Murasa and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Greenwarden of Murasa trigger.
Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Displace.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Greenwarden of Murasa and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

864-2103-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Capture of Jingzhou and Eternal Witness each turn.
864-2103-6122.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Eternal Witness by paying its mana cost.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Eternal Witness from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

738-2604-4659-6088.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature that is not indestructible.
Transmogrifying Wand has at least one charge counter on it.
738-2604-4659-6088.description:
Activate Transmogrifying Wand by paying {1}, tapping and removing a charge counter from it, targeting a creature an opponent controls.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Transmogrifying Wand, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Transmogrifying Wand ability, destroying the targeted creature and causing the opponent to create a 2/4 Ox creature token.
When the creature dies, Glissa triggers, returning Transmogrifying Wand from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Transmogrifying Wand by paying {1} due to Ugin, causing it to enter the battlefield with three charge counters on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2733-4050-5043.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, targeting any creature you control.
Alela triggers, creating three 1/1 Faerie creature tokens with flying.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Faerie tokens, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3693-4613-5735.notablePrerequisites:
Shay Cormac has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You have a way to give Shay Cormac deathtouch.
3693-4613-5735.description:
Give Shay Cormac deathtouch, if needed.
Activate Shay Cormac using Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting a creature an opponent controls.
Shay Cormac's first ability triggers, putting a bounty counter on the targeted creature.
Resolve the Shay Cormac ability from step 2, dealing 1 damage to the creature and killing it due to Shay Cormac's deathtouch.
When the creature dies, Shay Cormac's second ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.
If the method giving Shay Cormac deathtouch lasts indefinitely, you may repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

2511-4881-5011.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Cavalier of Night.
When Cavalier of Night dies, it triggers, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Activated Sleeper enters the battlefield, its first triggered ability from Cavalier of Night triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Activated Sleeper.
When Activated Sleeper dies, its last ability from Cavalier of Night triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Activated Sleeper enters the battlefield, it triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 5.

307-2792-4307.notablePrerequisites:
Yuriko and Great Whale do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Yuriko or Great Whale.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}{U}{B}.
307-2792-4307.description:
Declare Great Whale and Yuriko as attackers.
When they aren't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}{U}{B}.
Activate Thousand-Faced Shadow's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and returning Yuriko from the battlefield to your hand, putting Thousand-Faced Shadow onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Thousand-Faced Shadow enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a token copy of Great Whale that is tapped and attacking.
When the Great Whale token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Yuriko's ninjutsu ability by paying {U}{B} and returning Thousand-Faced Shadow from the battlefield to your hand, putting Yuriko onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
Deal combat damage using the Great Whale tokens, dealing infinite combat damage to the defending opponent.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}{U}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

422-524-1379.description:
Aether Storm prevents creature spells from being cast.
Darksteel Forge prevents Aether Storm from being destroyed due to its ability.
